correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated all 2^16 masks against all closed-neighborhood obstructions. Exactly 32391 faces, dimension counts (16,120,560,1804,4176,6976,8208,6462,3136,832,96,4). Reimplemented vertex-toggle matching: 16192 pairs, seven unmatched eight-vertex faces with exact printed bitmasks. Independently directed all 218672 nonempty Hasse cover incidences and consumed every one of 32390 nodes in a topological sort, proving acyclic matching. With a single critical 0-cell and seven 7-cells, Forman implies wedge of seven S7. Independent signed fixed-face Lefschetz enumeration gives (7,-1,3,-1,7,-1,3,-1); rational cyclotomic decomposition follows.
